label: Selected actual respects inherit every cut to the supply of their bearer's esse
paraphrase: Positive supply of the selected bearer's actuality in the original group interpretation, together with loss of its productive supply under every restriction of admitted groups that removes supply of the same bearer's esse. The intrinsic seeds are fixed. A cut is an operation on supply records. Identifying an actual giver's contribution, a physically admissible change or a respect-specific productive cause needs further evidence.
